test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Evasive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Truthful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Evasive"** means tending to avoid commitment or self-revelation, especially by responding only indirectly. (टालमटोल करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician gave an evasive answer to the reporter's question to avoid controversy.
 
 
 
• **"Truthful"** refers to someone who is honest and tells the truth, without hiding or avoiding facts. (सत्यवादी)
 
 
• **Example:** The child was truthful about breaking the vase and admitted her mistake.
